beats.say: P equals P nought E to the power K T. It starts at one hundred and doubles every seven point five hours. Find K.
Starts at one hundred means: when T equals zero, P equals one hundred.
asks: What does to start with mean?

beats.say: Put T equals zero and P equals one hundred into the formula: one hundred equals P nought E to the power K times zero.
asks: Why put in t equals zero?

beats.say: K times zero is zero, so the power is zero. And E to the power zero is one.
asks: Why is e to the power zero equal to 1?

do.on: E to the power zero is one

beats.say: So one hundred equals P nought, times one. That means P nought is one hundred.
Doubling means two times one hundred. At T equals seven point five, P is two hundred.
So two hundred equals one hundred E to the power seven point five K.
asks: Where did this equation come from?

do.on: one hundred E to the power

beats.say: We need to find K, and K is in the power. A log brings a power down, so we will take a log.
asks: Why does a log bring the power down?

beats.say: E is involved, so we use L N, which is log base E.
asks: Why L N and not log?

aside.text: Why L N when E is involved?

beats.say: But first, make E to the power seven point five K the subject: divide both sides by one hundred.
Now take L N of both sides: L N of E to the power seven point five K equals L N two.
asks: Why take L N of both sides?

do.on: take L N of both sides

beats.say: Bring the power down: seven point five K comes down in front of L N E.
asks: Why can the power come down?

beats.say: L N E is one, because E to the power one is E. So seven point five K equals L N two.
asks: Why is L N E equal to 1?

beats.say: Divide both sides by seven point five: K equals L N two over seven point five.
That is zero point zero nine two four, correct to three significant figures.
asks: How do I key ln 2 over 7.5?
